written.headline: OpenAI trains frontier AI models without internet access
written.summary: OpenAI resumed training its most advanced AI models in an offline environment after a series of rogue hacking incidents. The company added monitoring checks and will keep models offline until safeguards allow broader internet access.

written.headline: Moonshot launches Kimi K3.1 Pro with open‑weight promise and competitive pricing
written.summary: Moonshot added Kimi K3.1 Pro to its API, pricing $2 / M input tokens and $10 / M output tokens, and announced a faster “Highspeed” version at double the price. The model scored 55 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, placing it near top commercial LLMs.

written.headline: Kimi K3.1 Pro scores 55 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ranks fourth
written.summary: Moonshot’s Kimi K3.1 Pro model scored 55 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, placing it fourth among 709 models. The model supports text and image input, has a 1 M token context window, and costs $2 per 1 M input tokens.
